name: cloudtak-plugin-crowdcad
description: CloudTAK plugin — CrowdCAD for TAK dispatch board (read-only client of the CrowdCAD bridge)
//: Not built standalone: CloudTAK compiles plugins inside its own web build, which supplies vue, @tabler/icons-vue and @tak-ps/cloudtak. `npm run check` copies this plugin into a CloudTAK checkout (CLOUDTAK_DIR) and runs CloudTAK's own vue-tsc + eslint — the exact gate its Docker build enforces.
